title: Rodeo Valley Stable

services.name: Horse Hotel
services.desc: Please Note: No turn outs available for Horse Hotel guests. Confirmation of up-to-date vaccinations must be provided upon arrival. Must provide proof of liability insurance, and list Presidio Riding Club as "additionally insured for overnight stay at land owned by National Park Service" PRC Horse Hotel provides high quality grass hay and alfalfa. If your horse has other needs, please provide the food for feeding

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Located in the Marin Headlands within the Golden Gate National Recreation Area, a unit of the National Park Service, the Presidio Riding Club is a non-profit co-operative equestrian club with common goals of providing top quality care for our horses, preserving the site's historic structures, enjoying the breathtaking beauty of the Southern Marin Headlands, and acting as partners with and stewards for the public
